children: PMGC Holdings, through subsidiary NorthStrive Biosciences, entered into a First Amendment to its Development and License Agreement with Yuva Biosciences on Aug 27, 2026. The amendment launches a three-phase Expansion Program to advance up to four AI-discovered compounds toward lead nomination, and updates the AI Development Program scope, IP framework, and fields of use to Cardiac Diseases and Obesity. It also revises certain financial terms and definitions governing developed technology and AI results.
